tools.name: amount_in_words
tools.description: Writes an amount in Brazilian reais in words, in Brazilian Portuguese, the way it appears on receipts (1500,50 becomes "mil e quinhentos reais e cinquenta centavos"). Accepts 0 to 999.999.999,99. Stores nothing.

tools.name: list_document_types
tools.description: Lists the document types Reciba can draft from a conversation (payment receipt, rent receipt, service quote and service order, for Brazil) and the fields of each one, with the type id that prepare_document takes. Reads nothing about the person. Tax invoices (nota fiscal) and health-service receipts

tools.name: prepare_document
tools.description: Drafts a Brazilian payment receipt, rent receipt, service quote or service order on Reciba from the details in the conversation and returns a single-use link where the person reviews the full preview and issues it from their own Reciba account.
